text_block_list.text:
The "Fan Appreciation Festival"—a celebration packed
with various events for the fans who support the Umamusume—
On the day of the event, I spotted Tokai Teio looking exceptionally pumped up.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to the Fan Appreciation Festival!
I hope you enjoy yourselves to your hearts' content!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer.
Are you having fun too?
choice_data_list: Isn't the way you're talking a little weird?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You can't tell?
It's an impression of the President, of the President!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "Apparently the student council is completely swamped today and needs all the help they can get."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Prez personally came up to me
and asked if I could lend a hand!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So today, I am the President's proxy!
That is how it is, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Aaah! Wait, wait!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Once I actually started helping out,
it turned out to be way tougher than I thought.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So help me out too, Trainer! That's an order from the Student Council President!

At Tokai Teio's request,
we decided to explore the Fan Appreciation Festival together.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mmh!? That's an awfully long line
that's formed!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "The 'Beef Tendon Stew and Kushikatsu' snack set was unexpectedly popular, you see."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: What's that? It looks delicious!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, no. *Ahem*.
Understood. As the student council, we shall lend a hand.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Who...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Mmm... Good grief...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hayahide, is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"I'm in the middle of the scavenger hunt.
I'm looking for 'someone who can do 100 sit-ups.'"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, we in the student council shall resolve that problem.
We're counting on you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Do your best, for the sake of the academy!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...What kind of game is this?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mm-mm, seeing everyone having fun is what matters most!
Trainer, your hard work has been a tremendous help as well!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Jeez! Saying 'properly' is totally rude~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You know, Prez is an amazing runner, but she's also
super dignified and incredible as Student Council President, too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm standing in for the President, after all.
Of course I have to take it seriously!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Looks like a crowd's gathering
over by that stage. Let's go check it out.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Shine Bright! Idol Umamusume Championship"?!
I wonder if they'll be singing and dancing.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Uuu... What should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh? Is something the matter, Falco-kun?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Teio-chan... I was actually planning
to enter this contest, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The friend I was supposed to enter the unit division with
suddenly couldn't make it~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Even when I tell them, "Falco is twice as cute!", they won't listen to me...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I see, I see... I seeee...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like a job for the student council.
Alright, I'll go with you!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
R-Really!?
Thank you, Teio-chan!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, right now, I'm not Teio-chan...
I am (Acting) Student Council President Symboli Rudolf!

And so, Tokai Teio—or rather, Symboli Rudolf (Acting President)—
went around resolving various issues—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Teio, thank you for lending a hand today.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I did a gre~at job filling in
for the Prez!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Mhm... Words of gratitude have arrived from all sides.
You did a fine job.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
By the way, there is one rumor
I am rather curious about...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We've received enthusiastic requests for an additional live
from the unit that won a certain contest, you see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"For some reason, my name is listed
as part of that unit, though..."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah... Well, that's...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"And just moments ago, an idol costume
covered in heaps of frills arrived for me."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha... I'm sure it would
look great on the Prez, though...

Afterward, Tokai Teio was warned:
"Do not go around giving out names without permission."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
By the way, for some reason, my name was listed
on the unit that won a certain contest.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Uh-oh...
You mean idol Umamusume, right...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Honestly, having the nerve to use my name without permission...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However, every single fan watching
said they were "extremely satisfied."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...A unit with Smart Falcon
and Tokai Teio, you see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There's already talk of an encore performance.
This time, go out there and sing under your own name.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Yeah, got it!
I'll sing and dance out there as true to myself as I can be!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna make all my fans super happy!
Aiming for Umadol stardom!
And so, thanks in part to Tokai Teio's support,the Fan Appreciation Festival drew to a close with tremendous success.
